metadata.title: DIY: Headphones Pouch Tutorial
metadata.description:
Materials Needed:

scraps of fabric (main and lining pieces)
batting
soup container lid (about 4.5" in diameter)
zipper
key ring (optional)
coordinating thread
basic sewing supplies

Tutorial was found on Pinterest 
Original tutorial can be found here: 
http://www.dogundermydesk.com/2011/11/circle-zip-earbud-pouch-tutorial/

Find me on IG: apinchofdainty  or hashtag apinchofdainty
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

nodes.plm_action: Insert batting between layers
nodes.plm_caption:
A person is demonstrating how to complete ahomemade headphones case that is round, from materials. The items needed to make the case are all in the beginning of the video. At the beginning of the video, the completed product is shown.
The person begins by showing the material needed, which is felt and two patterns of fabric. Once the person has all the materials, they use a sewing machine to sew the patterned piece to the felt base and sew it on the opposite side of the small piece of felt with a zip attached in the middle. The person then pin it in place to have a smooth surface. The finished product of the pouch is shown before the person moves on to the next step.

summary.brief: A DIY tutorial shows how to make a round zippered headphones pouch.
summary.detailed: The video begins with a quick view of the finished floral‑patterned pouch holding a pair of earbuds, then the presenter displays the needed materials: main fabric, lining fabric, batting and a pink zipper. A soup‑can lid is used as a template to trace and cut 4½‑inch circles from each layer and to cut matching semicircles for the lining, batting and main fabric. One semicircle of lining is placed right‑side‑up, the zipper is laid on top, the main fabric is placed right‑side‑down, and the batting is sandwiched between them; the edges are pinned and sewn with a ¼‑inch seam allowance. The second semicircle of lining is stitched to the opposite side in the same way, forming a sealed circular sandwich. A 2‑inch square is folded, opened, its sides brought to the centre, folded again and top‑stitched on both long edges to create a reinforced tab. The tab is folded in half, aligned with the raw edge of the open circular seam, pinned and sewn in place. The entire assembly is then turned right‑side‑out, the excess zipper is trimmed, and a key‑ring is attached to the zipper pull. The completed pouch with earbuds inside is shown on a white surface before the video ends with a brief call‑to‑action.

action.detailed: Sew the lining, batting and main fabric together around a zipper, attach a folded fabric tab to close the seam, turn the pouch right‑side‑out, trim the excess zipper, and finish by adding a key ring.
action.actor: The presenter’s hands (craftsperson) performing the sewing and assembly

The view then cuts to a work surface covered by a green cutting mat where three circular fabric pieces are laid out: a printed fabric circle, a green fabric circle, and another circular piece, with a black square shape nearby. A hand lifts a clear plastic lid (bowl) and places it over the fabric circles, moving it to demonstrate their size and shape. The same hand then slides a long pink zipper across the mat, positioning it beside the fabrics. The hands continue to adjust and align the fabric circles, bringing one circle into contact with another as the segment nears its end.

action.detailed: Place the clear plastic lid onto the circular fabric pieces, align the pink zipper next to them, and adjust the fabric circles on the green cutting mat.

nodes.plm_action: Fold around lining
nodes.plm_caption:
A close-up shot of hands creating a circular pocket for earphones using a pink zipper. In the background is a green cutting mat.
The person takes 4 small round cutouts, with the same material, and places them on the center of the zipper. They then use velcro as a flap to close the bottom. Once, they put a round piece of fabric over the circular cutout to cover the outside. The fabric has a lot of flowers on it. The person then adds a zipper to the fabric, flips the fabric over to show the inside circle and shows the zipper. Once they've added both sides together, they are then able to put the fabric into their bag which then closes. The fabric bag also has a keyring attached to it. The hands, when finished, are removed to show the completed bag in its entirety.
There is a cut mat on the floor.

summary.brief: Hands sew a round zippered pouch for headphones and finish it with a key‑ring.
summary.detailed: The maker first places a semicircular piece of lining fabric right‑side up, lays a pink zipper (right‑side up) on it, adds the main fabric right‑side down with a layer of batting on top, pins the layers and stitches a ¼‑inch seam; the same steps are repeated with the second semicircular lining piece. A 2‑inch square is then folded, bias‑tape style, and the long edges are top‑stitched to form a tab, which is aligned with and sewn to the raw edges of the two semicircles. Next a full‑size main‑fabric circle is placed right‑side down, another batting layer is added, and the inner lining circle is placed right‑side up; the three layers are pinned and stitched all the way around. Excess zipper is trimmed, the pouch is turned right‑side out, a top‑stitch is added around the opening, a key‑ring is attached, headphones are placed inside and the zipper is closed, and the completed pouch is shown.

action.detailed: Place the lining semicircle right‑side up, lay the pink zipper on it, add the main fabric right‑side down with batting on top, pin and stitch; repeat for the second semicircle, fold a 2‑inch square into a bias‑tape tab and sew it to the raw edges, then sandwich the full‑size main‑fabric circle, batting and lining and stitch around, trim excess zipper, turn the pouch right‑side out, top‑stitch the opening, attach a key‑ring, insert headphones and zip closed.

There is a piece of fabric visible on the screen. The video cuts to a table with some fabric laid out on top of it. There appears to be a person's finger visible. The video then moves away again to what appears to be another piece of fabric. The end of the video ends with some blurry visuals.

summary.brief: A floral‑patterned round headphones pouch with a pink zipper and keychain is shown, then the presenter points to and manipulates several circular fabric pieces on a green cutting mat.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a product photo of a small round fabric pouch that has a pink zipper, a floral print and a keychain; white earbuds can be seen as the pouch is opened and closed while the title “DIY HEADPHONES POUCH” overlays the image. The view then cuts to a close‑up of the finished pouch with an earbud partially inserted, followed by a quick graphic of three circular fabric pieces. The scene shifts to a white table where the presenter touches the pouch and talks about the project. On a green, grid‑lined cutting mat three circular fabric pieces of different patterns are laid out. The presenter points to each circle, moves a piece of felt over the fabrics, and continues describing the materials.

action.detailed: Show the finished pouch, then point to each circular fabric piece on the cutting mat and move the felt overlay while speaking.

nodes.plm_action: Positioning fabric piece as the backing fabric on the batting circle

After that, there is a scene where a person is holding the bowl in the right hand and a light green fabric on the left hand and then putting it on a green flat surface and then a hand in the bottom pressing a pink zipper. Finally, the hand lifts the fabric from the work surface. There is also a circle fabric with white and black color in the work surface. The music is audible.

summary.brief: Hands hold a clear lid over fabric swatches, then slide a pink zipper across circular fabric pieces on a green cutting mat.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a close‑up of a hand holding a transparent circular lid, turning it to show its surface and placing it over several fabric swatches—a light‑green square and floral‑patterned circles—on a green cutting mat, pressing the fabrics beneath before lifting the lid away. The view then shifts to the same hand moving a long pink zipper across the mat, sliding it rightward over a group of circular fabric pieces of various colors and patterns while the presenter points and adjusts its position. The sequence ends with a small triangular fabric piece being placed near the zipper and a brief cut being made in a patterned fabric as background music plays.

action.brief: Arrange fabrics and position a zipper
action.detailed: Hold the clear circular lid, place it onto the fabric pieces on the cutting mat, press the fabrics beneath the lid, lift the lid, then slide the pink zipper across the mat, aligning it with the circular fabric pieces and adjust its position as shown.

nodes.plm_action: Slide zipper under fabric, ensuring edges are lined up.
nodes.plm_caption: This video features a close up shot of a person's hands, making a craft on a large grid surface. The surface is lime green with a red dotted pattern and small black lines to indicate measurements. The person is working on a pink zipper against a light red and white design on the top. As well as white felt. At the end, the person is holding a black felt piece. There are dark borders on either side.

summary.brief: Hands assemble a circular zippered pouch and fold a small fabric tab on a green cutting mat.
summary.detailed: The video shows close‑up hands working on a lime‑green grid cutting mat. A pink zipper is laid flat on the mat, then a red‑and‑white semicircular fabric piece is positioned on top of it. Additional fabric layers—such as a black‑and‑white patterned piece, a white fabric or batting, and another colored semicircle—are stacked around the zipper to form a sandwich. The maker aligns the edges, pins the layers together, and seams around the perimeter with a quarter‑inch allowance. Throughout, the hands adjust, press, and smooth the assembled fabric while the zipper remains centered. After the pouch is built, the hands pick up a small square of black fabric, fold it in half, then fold it again to create a compact tab, smoothing it flat and pointing to its edges. The segment ends with the folded piece held up for inspection.

action.detailed: Place the pink zipper on the cutting mat, layer the semicircular fabric pieces and batting around it, pin and sew around the edge, then fold the small black fabric square in half and again to form a compact tab.

nodes.plm_action: Attaching zipper to circle of felt
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a time-lapse of a woman crafting an item, featuring many different shots of her using different materials in a variety of settings to complete this project. The video ends with a still shot of the completed item.
The video begins with a close-up shot of a hand carefully balancing an eye on a piece of felt, then quickly cuts to the hand putting a strip of fabric in a zipper. The fabric is flipped over and then folded over a piece of lining and the sides pressed down with the woman pressing on another fabric and cutting off a small corner. After completing the small fabric bag she puts a piece of fabric on the outside and then attaches a piece of lined felt on the inside of the bag. At this point the women cuts the corner off the lining and runs the scissors along the edges. The video then shows a quick shot of her turning the bag right side out and putting a piece of felt on the outside of the bag.
The scene concludes with an overhead shot of her putting together all the parts together, and the woman, and the completed product is seen up close, finally the woman gets close enough and the video ends.
The video is set on a green graph paper background, with a few slight shadows seen in spots and the video is very bright. The ending shot is a close up shot on a bright white surface. The lighting is bright and natural.

summary.brief: Hands sew, trim, turn and zip a circular fabric pouch, then demonstrate it with earphones.
summary.detailed: Close‑up shots show a woman’s hands working on a green‑gridded cutting mat. First, a pink zipper is aligned with semicircular pieces of fabric and a small red fabric strip is attached; the layers are pinned and sewn together around the zipper with a quarter‑inch seam allowance. Excess zipper and fabric are trimmed, then the assembled circle is turned right‑side‑out and top‑stitched to finish the pouch. A piece of fluffy white fabric is placed over the interior, and the completed round pouch is opened, a pair of earphones is placed inside, and the zipper is closed. The segment ends with a clear view of the finished pink, black and white floral pouch on a white background, overlaid with brief promotional text.

action.detailed: Sew the fabric, lining and felt pieces together around the pink zipper, trim the excess, turn the circle right‑side‑out, top‑stitch the opening, then insert the earphones and zip the pouch closed.

The view then cuts to a light‑green cutting mat marked with a grid, where three round fabric pieces are arranged – a fuzzy white piece, a black‑white‑pink floral piece, and a red‑pink floral piece. The lid is then lifted, tilted and rotated so that both its top surface and its interior are visible; light passes through and a white, fluffy material inside the lid can be seen. nodes.plm_action: Aligning fabric pieces with zipper
nodes.plm_caption:
In the background, there is a green board of measurements with a pink zipper at the right and round designs of cloth on the board and someone is speaking.
In the foreground, there is a left hand of a person that is placed on the cloth and is touching the cloth in some parts. It then retracts and places them aside. The hand then grabs the zipper and moves it a little to the right, before placing it down. The hand then comes back and goes over the zipper that is to its right. The hand then exits the frame.

summary.brief: A left hand moves fabric pieces and places a pink zipper on a green cutting mat.
summary.detailed: The camera looks down at a green‑grid cutting mat covered with several circular fabric pieces in different prints (red, black‑white, floral, etc.), a fluffy white patch and a pink zipper laid along the right edge. The creator’s left hand first pinches the fluffy white material and slides it together with the printed circles into new positions on the mat. nodes.plm_action: Place half circle of fabric on zipper to align with fabric mark
nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows someone making a small purse with a pink zip. She measures the purse before putting the two zips together.
They start by touching a red semicircle shape and then a pink zip before holding a small black semicircle and touching it to the pink zip. They then begin assembling the two semicircles together, putting them onto the pink zip. They place a white piece of fabric on them before putting the red zip on top. The two pieces and the white fabric are flipped side to side, and the video ends with the zip opened.
The items are laid out on a green squared pattern cutting board.

summary.brief: The maker layers a semicircular lining, a pink zipper, the main fabric and batting, then pins and stitches them into a circular headphone pouch.
summary.detailed: Working on a green‑grid cutting mat, the crafter first places a right‑side‑up semicircular lining piece and lays a pink zipper on it. She then positions the main fabric right‑side‑down over the zipper, adds a strip of batting on top, pins the stack and sews a quarter‑inch seam around the edge, sandwiching the batting between the lining and the main fabric. The same sequence is repeated with the second semicircular lining piece and its zipper. After both halves are sewn, she aligns the two circles, stitches around the full perimeter and finishes the circular pouch.

action.detailed: Place a semicircular lining piece right‑side‑up, lay the pink zipper on it, position the main fabric right‑side‑down, add batting, pin the layers, sew a quarter‑inch seam around the edge, repeat with the second semicircle, then join and stitch the two halves to complete the circular pouch.

nodes.plm_action: Fold the neckband in half lengthwise
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a pair of hands manipulating two black items over a green grid surface.  They flip a tiny square piece of fabric between their hands and then flip it over so it is facing down.  They place it on the green board and flatten it.  They move a pinch of the bottom part of the fabric up. The left barefoot of someone comes into frame and the person uses their pointing finger to point at the backside of the item.
The video begins with hands manipulating black items over a green grid. They move the piece of fabric up and back and then place it on the green board.  They point at the backside of the fabric.
At 0:12, a barefoot appears. At the same time, the video fades to black.

summary.brief: Hands fold a small black fabric square into a tab on a green cutting mat and point to its back side.

She lifts the lower edge, folds the piece in half, then folds it again in the opposite direction, creating a compact folded tab. After the folds she holds the folded piece up, points with a finger to its reverse side while a bare foot briefly enters the frame, and the view then fades to black.

action.detailed: Place the black square on the green mat, smooth it, lift one edge and fold it in half, then fold it again in the opposite direction, hold the folded tab up and point to its back side.

nodes.plm_action: Pinning zipper in place
nodes.plm_caption: This video features a series of hands working on a pair of zippers to produce a matching hair bow. The two black and white circular pieces of fabric have matching zippers sewn into the middle of each. The zippers have a small pink piece of fabric sewn in the middle of the zipper. Each of the ends of the zippers is sewn with matching small pieces of the fabric that were used in the zippers and have two pins stuck in the center. The ends of the bow are still cut out, to fit on the end. The video ends with the woman holding a new piece of fabric while wearing the bow.

summary.brief: The maker sews a pink zipper between two black‑and‑white floral circles, joins them with a small red fabric piece, and reveals the finished zippered bow.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the crafter’s hands holding a red fabric strip and a pink‑zipped pouch, demonstrating how the zipper opens. She then places a pink zipper on a black‑and‑white floral circular piece, aligns the raw edges and pins it in place. The same process is repeated with a second identical circle, positioning it opposite the first and pinning the edges to the zipper. A small red square of fabric is stitched between the two circles to reinforce the connection, and the seams around the zipper are sewn. After turning the assembly right‑side‑out, she adjusts the zipper and shows the completed zippered bow (a bow‑shaped flap) resting on the green grid cutting mat.

action.brief: Sew pink zipper between two fabric circles
action.detailed: Align the pink zipper with the edge of the first floral circle, pin the raw edges, repeat with the second circle on the opposite side, stitch a red fabric square between the circles to secure them, sew around the zipper, turn the piece right‑side‑out and adjust the zipper to display the finished bow.

nodes.plm_action: Turn fabric inside out and pin in place
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a person sewing a zipper pouch to contain items such as earphones on a green board.
The person has used different pieces of fabric to make the pouch. There are pink, black, white, red, and grey colours featured in the fabric.

The beginning of the video shows an already made pouch of pink, black and white colours that the person places on top of the board. Then the person places the fabric of the same colour on top of the fabric already sewn onto the board.

The person places white cotton wool on the fabric, pins it onto the board, and then pushes a needle with thread and stitches. 

The person then turns the pouch inside out with one hand and cuts the ends with a pair of scissors in a circular motion. 

In the next frame, the person is holding another type of fabric that is pink, red, and white in colour.

The person then picks up a second pouch made with fabric of pink, black, and white colour with their right hand. The person then unzips the pouch on the top of a white board, puts white earphones into the pouch, and then zips it back shut. 

The video ends with a final cut of the finished pouch with earphones inside on a white surface. The white, black, and pink colours of the pouch can be seen.

The background of the video has a green board with a check grid. At the end the video also features white writing. The words say:  " Like. Comment. Subscribe! "

summary.brief: The creator finishes assembling the circular headphone pouch and displays the completed product.
summary.detailed: The hands place a white cotton‑wool batting onto a patterned fabric circle on a green grid, pin the layers together, and stitch around the edge while a pink zipper runs horizontally through the center; the sewn circle is then turned right‑side‑out, excess fabric and batting are trimmed with scissors, a second completed pouch is opened, white earphones are placed inside, the zipper is pulled shut, and the finished pink, black and white pouch with earphones is shown on a white surface with a “Like. Comment. Subscribe!” overlay.

action.detailed: Sew the fabric layers and batting together around the pink zipper, turn the pouch right‑side‑out, trim the excess material, insert the earphones, and zip it closed.

The bag is on a white background with a slight gradient towards the top of the shot, the bag is slightly darker the higher up it is.
nodes.llama3_caption:
The image shows a DIY headphones pouch with a pink zipper and a keychain attached to it. The pouch is made of fabric and has a black, white, and red pattern.

* A pink zipper:
	+ The zipper is open, revealing the contents of the pouch.
	+ It is attached to the top of the pouch and has a small handle on the side.
* A keychain:
	+ The keychain is attached to the zipper handle.
	+ It is a small metal ring with a clip on the end.
* A pouch:

summary_sent_to_llm.title: DIY: Headphones Pouch Tutorial
summary_sent_to_llm.description:
Materials Needed:

scraps of fabric (main and lining pieces)
batting
soup container lid (about 4.5" in diameter)
zipper
key ring (optional)
coordinating thread
basic sewing supplies

Tutorial was found on Pinterest 
Original tutorial can be found here: 
http://www.dogundermydesk.com/2011/11/circle-zip-earbud-pouch-tutorial/

Find me on IG: apinchofdainty  or hashtag apinchofdainty
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video begins with a quick view of the finished floral‑patterned pouch holding a pair of earbuds, then the presenter displays the needed materials: main fabric, lining fabric, batting and a pink zipper. A soup‑can lid is used as a template to trace and cut 4½‑inch circles from each layer and to cut matching semicircles for the lining, batting and main fabric. One semicircle of lining is placed right‑side‑up, the zipper is laid on top, the main fabric is placed right‑side‑down, and the batting is sandwiched between them; the edges are pinned and sewn with a ¼‑inch seam allowance. The second semicircle of lining is stitched to the opposite side in the same way, forming a sealed circular sandwich. A 2‑inch square is folded, opened, its sides brought to the centre, folded again and top‑stitched on both long edges to create a reinforced tab. The tab is folded in half, aligned with the raw edge of the open circular seam, pinned and sewn in place. The entire assembly is then turned right‑side‑out, the excess zipper is trimmed, and a key‑ring is attached to the zipper pull. The completed pouch with earbuds inside is shown on a white surface before the video ends with a brief call‑to‑action.
action_list: Arrange fabrics and position a zipper
Show fabric pieces and cut fabric
Sew pink zipper between two fabric circles
Trim excess fabric and display pouch
Attach fabric layers to a pink zipper
Attach zipper and fabric tab to circular fabric
Pin and stitch fabric onto zipper
Fold and align red fabric strip
